class: Every list, search box and date filled one way, and an option matched by loose words
symptom: Live runs on 29 September left basic fields empty or wrong: a Greenhouse country list offering 'United States +1' was not matched to 'United States', a degree list offering 'Master' was not matched to 'Masters of Science', a Lever location search was typed into but no suggestion picked, a BambooHR state menu and date boxes were left for the owner; the owner asked why the agent could not answer basic questions.
site: Greenhouse (react-select), Lever and Rippling (server-suggested locations), BambooHR (button menus), Ashby, and any portal with mm/dd/yyyy or month/year date boxes
root_cause: The agent had one way to fill a list -- type the answer and look for a row with the same words -- and one date shape. Portals build these controls differently (reference/ats_fields/): react-select opens only on a real press, a location list arrives from the server a moment later and redraws, a menu has its own search box, a date box takes the format its placeholder shows. And the words of an option were compared loosely, or not at all when a dial code or the portal's own word for a degree stood beside the answer.
why_tests_missed: The tests used native selects and rows spelled exactly as the profile spells them; none drew a list the way a portal does (opening on a press, arriving late, redrawing), offered the answer in another portal's words, or asked for a date in another shape.
fix: option_match.best_option is the one matcher for every list: the same words; the same place in any spelling with a dial code set aside (geo_reference); the same answer in the portal's own words (reference/answer_equivalents.json); the whole answer then only more after punctuation -- never 'contains' ('Virginia' is not 'West Virginia'), and no pick when two are equally good. form_fields.choose opens each kind of list the way it opens (a native select, an Ant list through interaction.resolve_ant_dropdown, a real press, typing, waiting for the rows to settle, clicking the row, again if the list redraws) and confirms the box shows the answer; it never presses Enter. choose_several ticks a checkbox group; fill_date writes the date in the shape the box takes. inventory_pass fills lists, search boxes and dates the usual reading left empty.
prevention: Study how each target portal draws its controls before writing the filler, and build test pages in those shapes (late, redrawing, opened by a press). Keep one matcher for every list, with the portals' vocabularies as data, and make 'contains' impossible by construction.
